name: Palestine

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of black, white and green, with a red triangle at the hoist.
flag.symbolism: The Pan-Arab colours derive from the flag of the 1916 Arab Revolt and are associated with historic Arab dynasties.

hook: Palestine is black-white-green with a plain red triangle; Jordan adds a white star to the triangle, and Sudan's triangle is green.
trivia: The flag was adopted by the Palestine Liberation Organization in 1964 and by the State of Palestine when it declared independence in 1988.
It was first raised at United Nations headquarters in New York in September 2015, alongside the flags of member states.
